name: Gazlowe's Wisdom alone keeps Remote Detonation known
contract: Gazlowe's Wisdom 803074 is a passive talent aura; with it, Sticky Bomb Explosion 801009 spawns Shrapnel Mines
(850020, creature 50600) under its target (spell_ascension_tinker_ability), so a Tinker who knows no mine spell
can still have a live mine. Remote Detonation 801798 is gated by CasterAuraSpell Bomb Ready 500354 from a live
mine, so AscensionTinker::Refresh keeps it known for every Tinker that can place a mine. Expected: with
Gazlowe's Wisdom and no Blast or Shrapnel Mine spell, Remote Detonation is known; once the talent is unlearned

steps.label: SETUP: no mine spell is known
